lastCompletedStory.title: Implement finalizeCycleClose() in src/ with injectable deps

nextStoryContext: finalizeCycleClose() is now implemented in src/commands/ship-finalize.ts with fully injectable deps (spawnFn, clock, readProjectToml, readPrd, readIssues, writeIssues). The SpawnFn type mirrors the one in src/commands/resume.ts. All 4 acceptance-criteria scenarios are covered by test/ship-finalize.test.ts (none-backend, github-backend, linear-backend, dirty-prd.json). The function is synchronous. Next story can wire this into cam ship --finalize or the supervisor.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Implementation uses only in-repo parseToml wrapper (Bun.TOML.parse already validated in toml.ts), JSON builtins, and a type import from node:child_process. No new external library API was called.
